intent.statement: Build a small pet clinic scheduler covering owners, appointments, and vaccination reminders.
intent.normalized: pet clinic scheduler: owners, appointments, vaccination reminders

glossary.definition: A person registered with the clinic who holds one or more pets.
A booked time slot between an Owner and the clinic.
A dated entry tracking one vaccine administered to a pet.

assumptions.statement: The clinic runs a single location, so no multi-tenancy is required.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Every entity would need tenant scoping and access checks.

requirements.statement: The system shall let an **Owner** book, reschedule, and cancel an **Appointment**.
The system shall store **Owner** contact details together with a change history.
The system shall show a reminder when a **Vaccination Record** is overdue.

decisions.decision: Persist clinic data in SQLite behind a repository interface.
decisions.rationale: A single clinic needs zero-ops storage; the repository interface keeps a later migration to Postgres open.

alternatives.rejected_because: No operations staff to run a server at the clinic.

tasks.title: Appointment scheduling
tasks.purpose: Deliver booking, rescheduling, and cancellation for appointments.
invariants: No appointment may be booked outside clinic opening hours
tasks.instructions: Implement the appointment service on top of the repository interface; keep every write inside src/appointments.

cases: REQ-0001: booking an appointment persists it
REQ-0001: cancelling frees the slot for rebooking

acceptance: Owners can book and cancel appointments through the service
tasks.rollback: Revert the appointments module commit and delete its migration.

tasks.title: Owner records
tasks.purpose: Store owner contact details with a full change history.
invariants: Contact detail edits never overwrite history
tasks.instructions: Implement the owners module with an append-only history table; keep every write inside src/owners.

cases: REQ-0002: editing owner contact details records a history entry

tasks.rollback: Revert the owners module commit and delete its migration.

risk.note: Follows the repository pattern already in place

tasks.title: Vaccination reminders
tasks.purpose: Surface a reminder whenever a vaccination record is overdue.
invariants: Reminder scans are read-only against appointment data
tasks.instructions: Implement the overdue-record scan and the reminder projection inside src/vaccinations.

cases: REQ-0003: an overdue vaccination record surfaces a reminder
